note: Set B is identical to Set A except that it additionally captures the 'DOOR FRAME & WALL TRIM FIN. W/ P4' note as a finish claim (finish P4), which the page clearly supports and which A omits. Both sets share the same defects: several dimensions from the West Living and West Bedroom elevations are dumped under a fabricated 'Wall section' entity (and 8'-8" is bound to WEST LIVING ELEVATION when it belongs to the WEST BEDROOM ELEVATION), the 4 1/2" near W2 is given an invented 'depth' attribute, and several dimensions are duplicated under two names. Since the shared claims are identical, B's extra correct claim makes it the better set.
remarks: Shared problems: 'Wall section' is not an entity on the page — 13'-3 3/4", 3'-9 11/16", 2'-11 3/16", 1'-6" are dimensions of the West Living Elevation; 8'-8" (and 9'-10 1/4", 9'-2") belong to the West Bedroom Elevation, not WEST LIVING. 'interior elevation' is likewise a vague entity for the South/West Bedroom dimensions. Duplicates: 3'-9 11/16", 2'-11 3/16" and 1'-6" each appear twice under different names. The 'presence | installed' claims for WB/P1/P2/F1/F2/MWD02 and the 'component' claims are label restatements with an unsupported 'installed' value. Facts on the page neither shown set captures (or at least not in the samples): 9'-11 1/2", 9'-2 3/4", 3'-6 1/4", 4'-3", 4 1/4", 1/2", 2 5/8", 1'-5 3/4", 9'-10 1/4", components D3, P3, P4, TV, MWD01, and the C3/A3 detail references.
